title: NPC
description: A non-player character in the case.

description.description: Description of the NPC's appearance, background, and demeanor.

role.description: Whether this NPC is central to the case or part of the environment.

known_claim_ids.description: Claims this NPC knows about and can reference.

lie_claim_ids.description: Claims this NPC will lie about (intentionally give false information).

forbidden_fact_ids.description: Facts this NPC must never reveal under any circumstances.

formality.description: How formal the NPC's speech is (0=casual, 1=very formal).

anxiety.description: How anxious the NPC appears (0=calm, 1=highly anxious).

initial_location_id.description: Scene ID where this NPC starts.

default_emotion.description: Default emotional state of the NPC (e.g. neutral, guarded, friendly).
